thesis: The page is a carbon-copy pour ticket: every section is a numbered line item from dig to cure, and the signature is the perforated edge + carbon-blue duplicate offset that grows as you scroll.

signature.name: Carbon-Copy Pour Ticket
signature.summary: A dashed-left-border ticket line with a carbon-blue offset copy that pulls away on hover; step numbers in mono; a right-margin 28-day strength curve advances via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, reviews, tools, form and footer.

palette.family: Ticket Paper + Carbon Blue + Safety Orange

motion.intro: Ticket feeds up via clip-path reveal line by line (60ms stagger); SAMPLE TICKET stamp lands scale 1.08→1 over 200ms, no bounce.
stories: Pinned slab cross-section builds layer by layer as line items 01-08 tick (verb: stack)
Right-margin 28-day strength curve counts day 0→28 with walk-on/drive-on/full-strength ticks (verb: count)
motion.hover: Carbon-blue offset shifts -2px,2px to -4px,4px on ticket-lines (verb: pull)
